newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Sanacorp to boost chemist distribution.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Sanacorp to boost chemist distribution.

text.p: Munich-based pharmaceuticals distributor Sanacorp Pharmahandel AG said on Monday it would be expanding its distribution of vaccines, medical dressings and other supplies to doctors' surgeries and consultancies.
Sanacorp, which earlier this year trialed the distribution of such goods through chemist chains, said it now planned to extend its distribution chain to over 2,000 chemist outlets "in the near-term".
The company also said in a statement it expected a "significantly positive contribution from consultancy and so-called "home-care" activities in the 1996/97 financial year.
Sanacorp, which according to press reports is seeking a Frankfurt stock listing for the second half of October, said it made a profit on turnover of some 3.5 billion marks in the 1995/96 year.
